title: Clinical Guide: (UM) Utilization Management Nurse (Outpatient Prior Authorizatio
description:
Job Description
A bit about this role:
As a Clinical Guide on our Outpatient Utilization Management team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of our members. You’ll be responsible for clinical review of outpatient authorization requests - applying evidence-based medical necessity criteria, CMS and Medicare Advantage requirements, and health plan policy to determine whether requested services are appropriate. Your decisions help members get the right care in the right setting, and help them navigate the healthcare system with confidence.
Our ideal Clinical Guide is detail-oriented, solutions-focused, and comfortable making well-documented clinical judgments at pace. You’re someone who can hold accuracy and volume at the same time, and who is energized rather than unsettled by evolving policies and workflows.
Schedule:
This is a full-time, remote position working five 8-hour days, 40 hours per week. We are hiring for the following schedules:
Monday - Friday, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM ET
Monday - Friday, 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM ET
Sunday - Thursday, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM ET
We’ll ask about your schedule preference during the process and will do our best to match it. Because we’re filling a limited number of openings on each schedule, availability changes as roles are filled - so we ask that candidates be open to more than one schedule where possible.
Your responsibilities and impact will include:

• Conduct timely, comprehensive clinical review of outpatient authorization requests, applying evidence-based medical necessity criteria, CMS and Medicare Advantage requirements, and health plan policies.

• Review requests across multiple authorization categories - including outpatient procedures, imaging, therapy, DME, and home health - each with its own criteria and resources.

• Determine the appropriateness of requested services and the appropriate setting of care, recommending clinically appropriate alternatives where relevant.

• Refer cases that do not meet criteria to the Medical Director for secondary review; prepare clinical summaries and support peer-to-peer discussions.

• Communicate with providers and internal teams to obtain additional clinical documentation and resolve open questions.

• Meet CMS turnaround time standards while maintaining accuracy across a high volume of requests.

• Maintain accurate, defensible documentation of every determination, in line with CMS regulations, Medicare Advantage requirements, and internal compliance standards.

• Apply clinical judgment on complex cases - gathering additional information and escalating when appropriate.

• Identify, document, and communicate potential quality assurance or risk management issues.

• Explain complex clinical and coverage information clearly to providers and internal partners.

Required skills and experience:

• An unrestricted RN license with a minimum of 4 years of RN experience.

• Minimum 3 years of utilization management, utilization review, or prior authorization experience within a health plan, hospital, or post-acute setting.

• Knowledge and understanding of CMS guidelines and Medicare Advantage requirements.

• Experience escalating cases that do not meet criteria, including preparing clinical summaries for physician review.

• Comfort in a fast-paced environment with daily turnaround standards and frequently changing policies, criteria, and workflows.

• The ability to comfortably multi-task - you’ll be listening, talking, and typing at the same time.

Desired skills and experience:

• Outpatient prior authorization experience - home health and DME a significant plus.

• Proficiency with technology, including Google Workspace and AI tools.

• The ability to break down complex information and adjust your approach to different audiences.

• Transparency in your work - what’s going well and what isn’t.

• A desire to change the healthcare experience: you love to serve and make a difference.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Validio is the agentic data management platform that automates data quality, lineage, and cataloging - so enterprises can finally trust the data behind their analytics, AI, and reporting. As a Data Scientist on our Algorithm team, you build the models at the heart of the product - the Anomaly Detection that separates good data from bad.

A validator watches a metric over time; an ML model decides, for each new value as it arrives, whether it's anomalous and worth waking someone up for. These models run against tens of thousands of time series at once - unattended, unlabeled, with nobody tuning them per customer. You'll own that end to end: reading a metric from a customer's warehouse, running the algorithm online in our pipeline, and persisting the state it carries between runs, fast and reliably at scale.

What you'll do

- Build the algorithmic core - anomaly detection, plus data profiling, SQL generation, lineage parsing, and change point detection

- Take a method from a research paper to a tested prototype, then to a production model running online in the engine

- Work out why a validator over-alerts on a metric - say one with a strong daily and weekly cycle - and reshape how it forms its expected range

- Tell whether a model change actually improved detection across customers, when there's no labelled set to score against

- Keep a validator's metrics correct and fast in SQL across multiple warehouses

- Work with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Support - on the call when the customer describes the problem

What you'll bring

- ML models you've built and deployed to production, serving real predictions to users

- A strong grounding in statistical modelling - the assumptions a method makes, how it estimates uncertainty, and how it fails when the data breaks them

- Fluent Python, and either some Rust already or the appetite to learn it here

- SQL well beyond SELECT - window functions, query plans, dialect differences, and why a query that flies on one warehouse is unusable on another

- An instinct for performance - reasoning about CPU, memory, and bottlenecks when you implement a new algorithm

- The range to carry a problem from a vague business need through prototype to measured impact, and to direct AI tools well - knowing what they get subtly wrong

Bonus points for

- Time series, signal processing, anomaly detection, or unsupervised methods

- Inference engineering - optimising runtimes and model throughput on general-purpose hardware

Our stack, and why Rust for most of the engine and backend. Python for exploration and prototyping in the Algorithm team, where modelling usually starts, and for parts of the service like the SDK and IaC tooling. SQL in every dialect that matters - we push computation down to the warehouse when we can and stream through our own pipeline when we can't. Postgres and Redis for state, Kubernetes and Helm to deploy, which lets us run Validio both as SaaS and fully air-gapped. Claude, Gemini, and Codex in daily use.

Why Validio Founded in Sweden in 2019, we're trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, Truecaller, Traveloka, and Deutsche Glasfaser. We raised a $30M Series A this year and grew ARR 800% in twelve months as enterprises got serious about making their data AI-ready. At around 40 people, you'll own initiatives end to end and make the call when you're closest to the problem - strict about testing and documentation, and fast about decisions.

Come as you are. We hire for what you'll build with us, and we welcome applicants of every background.

title: Chief Legal Officer (CLO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

• Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.

• Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.

• Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.

• Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.

• Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.

• Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.

• Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

• Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.

• Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.

• Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.

• Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

• Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.

• Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.

• Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.

• Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

• Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.

• Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.

• Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

• Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

• Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.

• Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.

• Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.

• Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.

• Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.

• Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

• Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.

• Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.

• 15+ years of progressive legal experience.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).

• Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.

• Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.

• Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

title: Change Manager
description:
Do našeho skladu v Ostravě hledáme Change Managera, který si vezme na starosti řízení projektů a zavádění změn do praxe. Tvým cílem bude vyladit náš fungující provoz tak, aby šlapal ještě chytřeji a efektivněji. Nečeká tě žádné slepé udržování starých pořádků. Naopak - dostaneš prostor přehodnotit dosavadní fungování, ovlivnit naše standardy a od prvního dne za sebou zanechat viditelnou stopu.

 

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Kompletní řízení projektů: Budeš mít pod palcem celý zásobník změn i projektů pro náš sklad a dohlédneš na to, aby se nové iniciativy hladce zavedly do běžného provozu.

- Propojování týmů a dat: Budeš sledovat KPI, vyhodnocovat výsledky a propojovat lokální i centrální týmy ohledně priorit a zdrojů.

- Inovace a standardizace: Podpoříš zavádění nových procesů, nástrojů a systémů. Tvým cílem bude přinášet osvědčené postupy, nastavovat vysoké standardy a zjednodušovat týmu každodenní práci.

- Udržitelnost změn: Postaráš se o to, aby změny nebyly jen spuštěné na papíře, ale aby je lidé v provozu opravdu pochopili, vzali za své a fungovaly dlouhodobě.

- Podpora v nejexponovanějších časech: Během špiček (Peak periods) se nezalekneš provozu - pomůžeš přímo na place s operativním řešením problémů a sledováním dat.

Jak si tě představujeme?

- Máš praxi v oboru: Máš za sebou 3-5 let zkušeností v oblasti řízení změn (Change Management), logistiky nebo Supply Chain.

- Jsi silný v projektech i datech: Máš skvělé projektové dovednosti, analytické myšlení a k řešení problémů přistupuješ na základě čísel a dat.

- Máš skvělé komunikační schopnosti: Umíš koordinovat lidi, vést je k výsledkům a udržet v hlavě více priorit současně i v rychlém prostředí.

- Zvládneš angličtinu i češtinu: Anglicky se bez problému domluvíš s centrálními a mezinárodními týmy, češtinu využiješ pro každodenní hladkou komunikaci s lidmi přímo na skladě.

- Tvojí výhodou bude: VŠ vzdělání, certifikace Lean / Six Sigma / projektové řízení a zkušenost s WMS či analytickými nástroji.

Co ti za tvou práci nabídneme?

- Férovou a jasnou odměnu: Dostaneš atraktivní fixní mzdu. Žádné složité bonusové hry ani interní politika - skvělou práci odměňujeme přímo a férově.

- Dotované obědy a občerstvení na pracovišti zdarma: Čeká tě oběd zdarma, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce i zelenina po celý den. Protože dobré jídlo je základ dobré práce.

- Placené volno navíc: Víme, že odpočinek je důležitý. Kromě klasické dovolené si u nás po dohodě s týmem a s ohledem na provoz můžeš vzít i další placené volno navíc.

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma: Nakupuj pro sebe s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na nákup na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport & wellbeing: Zůstaň v kondici s dotovanou Kartou Multisport nebo se zapoj do našich týmových sportovních výzev.

- Bezpečné a moderní prostředí: Budeš pracovat v moderním zázemí skladu s vybavením a podporou, kterou potřebuješ pro bezpečnou a pohodovou práci.

- Tým, který drží při sobě: V provozu jsme na jedné lodi. Budeš součástí party lidi, kteří si navzájem pomáhají a společně zvládají každodenní výzvy.

- Práce, která má reálný dopad: Díky tobě se čerstvé jídlo dostane včas k tisícům zákazníků. Každá změna a projekt, který úspěšně zavedeš, okamžitě posune celý provoz dopředu.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
The Cyber Security Analyst will be responsible for protecting all of the companys hardware, software, and networks from cybercriminals. The analyst's primary role will be to understand the company IT infrastructure in detail in order to detect, evaluate and respond to threats that could potentially breach the network. The Cyber Security Analyst provides specific guidance and coaching to key security areas, e.g. key and encryption, secure software development. In this capacity, a cyber security analyst is part of the proactive work to help shape the tech delivery of the organization.The successful incumbent must possess excellent analytical, communication skills and be solution oriented.
RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES
Responsible for understanding the global threat landscape and acting on threat intelligence.
Conduct cyber security incident response, following industry standards of containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.
Manage containment and eradication of threats and remediation of environment during or after an incident, including identifying potential business impact and communication with stakeholders
Manage information security-related breaches
Document event analysis and write reports of incident investigations.
Perform forensic analysis on threat indicators and intelligence insight and identify impact of vulnerabilities
Support the tech delivery in product and services teams with expert security knowledge relevant to a specific technology area or domain (e.g. Key & encryption, secure software development)
Develop the required processes and tools to support the tech delivery teams
Define and develop security guardrails relevant to the tech area/domain
The above responsibilities are indicative of the work required and should not be seen as an exhaustive list.
KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
Security solutions (proxy, email gateway, IDS/IPS, FW, SIEM, SOAR, EDR etc.)
Cloud, key and encryption management, SDLC concepts
IT and security architecture
Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
BSc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Information Security or any related field (or equivalent work experience).
Minimum of 3 years experience in the field
Penetration testing (OWASP, MITRE etc.) experience
Cyber Security certifications (e.g. Security+, GCIA, GCIH, GREM, CISSP, CEH, GCFA)
DESIRED ATTRIBUTES AND BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES
Apply fundamental security concepts to cyber defense and understand business and risk to guide the cyber defense day to day operations.
Manage cases with enterprise SIEM or Incident Management systems
Support network investigations and network monitoring in a SOC environment.
Perform vulnerability assessment and penetration testing
SPECIAL CONDITIONS

N/A
FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS
External: N/A
Internal: Development team, Tech Lead, CTO
PERFORMANCE CRITERIA
Timely delivery of agreed daily, weekly and monthly KPIs

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Air Dominance and Strike (AD&S) Chief Engineering Team is the technical authority for our most critical programs. They are responsible for owning the technical baseline, leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams through rigorous development and flight test and delivering revolutionary airborne systems that meet the mission. They are the ultimate problem-solvers, driving technical execution from architecture to operational demonstration.

ABOUT THE JOB
Anduril is looking for strong technical leaders to spearhead the development of new capabilities for new customers. You’ll own the technical development from concept refinement through detailed design, build, and flight test of new aircraft concepts. These projects will require you to leverage your technical expertise and leadership skills to set objectives, build a team, and produce real products on a rapid timeline. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience in programmatic level decision making will play a key component in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success while carefully balancing risk and execution speed. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead Technical Execution : Own the technical baseline and lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team (aerodynamics, structures, GNC, propulsion, avionics, software) through detailed design, system integration, and verification.

• Oversee Prototype Build & Integration:  Coordinate the fabrication and assembly of prototype and development articles, resolving engineering challenges that arise during the build process.

• Drive the Test Campaign:  Lead the engineering team in planning and executing a comprehensive test program, including ground test, SIL/HIL integration, and developmental flight test, to validate performance and expand the operational envelope.

• Manage System Design & Architecture:  Guide the team through critical design trades, sub-system optimization, and interface management to ensure a cohesive and high-performance air vehicle architecture.

• Ensure Airworthiness & Safety:  Serve as the technical authority for system safety and partner with test teams to develop the data and artifacts required to achieve military flight releases.

• Problem Solve & Troubleshoot:  Act as the lead technical problem-solver, driving root cause analysis and implementing effective solutions for issues discovered during integration and testing.

• Prepare for Production:  Partner with the manufacturing engineering team to ensure the design is production-ready (DFM/DFA) and support a clean transition to production.

• Support deployed flight test and demonstration activities at customer and test sites.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience as a Chief Engineer, Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead, or senior technical leader on a Low-Observable ISR and/or strike platform.

• Deep, hands-on experience leading a multi-disciplinary team through at least one major phase of aircraft EMD (e.g., detailed design, prototype build, or flight test).

• Proven track record of taking a complex aircraft system from design into build and successful flight testing.

• Strong technical foundation

The Role

The Lead Development Analyst is responsible for identifying, validating, and enriching high-confidence license management opportunities. This role combines elements of sales development, open-source research, and quality assurance into a single, end-to-end workflow. Analysts operate across the full lifecycle of lead development, from discovery through validation, ensuring that only well-researched, high-quality opportunities are submitted to the sales team. Success in this position requires analytical thinking, attention to detail, and strong judgment when working with incomplete or ambiguous data.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Discovery & Identification

• Identify potential compliance opportunities using curated datasets, link lists, and online repositories

• Apply structured and creative approaches to uncover relevant leads

2. Document Analysis & Forensics

• Examine PDF documents to detect usage of iText or related technologies

• Identify licensing indicators (e.g., AGPL references)

• Assess the strength and reliability of evidence

3. Organization & Entity Validation

• Determine the organization responsible for document creation

• Validate company location and ICP alignment

• Resolve incomplete or ambiguous entity data

4. Lead Qualification & Validation

• Apply acceptance criteria to determine lead eligibility

• Ensure submissions meet evidence and ICP thresholds

• Maintain high first-pass quality and minimize rejected leads

5. Data Entry & CRM Integrity

• Input validated leads into Salesforce

• Attach supporting documentation

• Maintain accuracy and consistency across records

6. Data Enrichment & Analysis

• Enhance leads with additional company context and evidence

• Identify trends to improve targeting

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work with OSLD leadership to refine lead quality and frameworks

• Collaborate with Sales and Marketing Teams to continuously improve Lead generation and research

Qualifications

Required:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• High attention to detail

• Ability to evaluate ambiguous information

• Experience with Excel and CRM systems

Preferred:

• Experience in SDR, QA, or compliance research roles

• Familiarity with AGPL or open-source licensing

• Multilingual capabilities

Key Traits for Success:

• Investigative mindset

• Strong judgment and decision-making

• Accountability for quality and output

• Critical thinking

Why This Role Is Unique

• Combines lead generation, validation, and QA

• Focuses on quality and business impact

• Exposure to sales strategy and license management processes

• Direct impact on revenue pipeline

Compensation Philosophy

The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.

• A comprehensive extended benefits package including health, dental and vision for you and your family, with company paid offerings.

• An uncapped commissions structure.

• Generous paid time off (PTO) is offered to support the ability to rest and recharge.

• A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.

• Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.

• Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office.

• Ongoing support for learning development so you can master your craft.

• Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac).

• Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years in corporate, enterprise, or endpoint security at a fast-growing tech company.

- Deep expertise in identity (Google Workspace/Okta/Entra, SSO, SCIM, conditional access), MDM (Jamf/Kandji/Intune), and SaaS security posture (SSPM).

- You can write code (Python, Bash, or Go) and treat policies as software - versioned, tested, deployed.

- Strong instincts for IT risks such as phishing, social engineering, and insider risk - including the new AI-flavored variants.

- Pragmatic about UX. You know when a control is real security and when it's just friction.

- Bonus: experience securing AI tools and agents in the workplace (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, et al).

- Bonus: experience managing hardware security keys

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the security of Lovable's corporate environment: identity, endpoints, SaaS, email, and the AI tools we live in.

- Roll out and maintain controls that scale - passkeys, device trust, conditional access, DLP, SSPM.

- Run phishing, awareness, and tabletop programs that actually change behavior.

- Work on Detection & Response to make detection of insider and account-takeover risk first-class.

- Secure and optimise our diverse AI toolstack, including Lovable itself, working closely with the product team on feedback and iterations

- Help the Security and GRC teams make least-privilege the default and auditability free.

- Ensure the right data is surfaced to the right people, while implementing data classifications and reducing the risk of data loss

OUR STACK

- Devices: macOS, Linux, Kandji, Crowdstrike

- Networking: Tailscale, Cloudflare, Meter, Unifi

- IAM: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra

- Dev tools/data: Lovable, GitHub, BigQuery, various AI tools

Job Description Summary
‎
Provides evidence-based nutrition care and education to patients participating in nutrition education and weight management programs. title: People Operations Lead
description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)
🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.
✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!

About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.

Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

In practice:

- You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data.

- You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them.

- You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

- You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and good at bringing people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

- Significant People Operations experience, with ownership of end-to-end People processes.

- Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems.

- Strong numerical reasoning and advanced Excel skills - you're comfortable reconciling data, spotting anomalies and turning numbers into useful insight.

- Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

- A track record of continuous improvement and using systems, data and technology to make People Ope

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Astrana Health builds the technology that lets physician groups deliver value-based care: the systems that enables physicians to deliver higher quality care and keeps its payers, and its partners in sync. Our engineers work on anything from eligibility, claims, and authorizations data, integrations with payer and provider systems, clinical integrations, provider-facing tools, and the data platform that ties them together. The pace varies with the work. Some of it is fast iteration with real users. Some of it touches PHI, billing, or clinical decisions and has to be right the first time. We want engineers who can tell which kind of work is in front of them and adjust. We also expect engineers to work across the whole stack: database, backend, frontend, and the infrastructure that runs it.

As a Senior Engineer you own a product surface or a significant system end to end. We hand you problems rather than solutions. You take a fuzzy problem to a data model, an API, a UI, a rollout plan, and shipped software, and you bring the people around it with you: your PM, clinical and operations stakeholders, and the more junior engineers you mentor.

Our Values:

• Put Patients First

• Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams

• Operate with Integrity & Excellence

• Be Innovative

• Work As One Team

What You'll Do

• Own the architecture, reliability, and technical direction for a product surface or system.

• Ship full-stack features end to end, from schema and API through to the React UI. Iterate quickly where the risk is low and be thorough where it is not.

• Decompose larger problems into work that several people can pick up in parallel, and adjust as you learn.

• Design data models that survive requirements nobody has heard yet, and integrations that stay correct when the systems on the other side misbehave.

• Work with the data directly. Answer questions about eligibility, claims, and quality data with SQL, notice when the numbers look wrong, and build the reporting and analytics that clinics and operations teams rely on.

• Run schema and data migrations safely: expand/contract, backfills, staged cutovers, and a rollback path you have actually thought through.

• Take systems from "works" to "runnable by someone else": meaningful logging, alerts, and runbooks.

• Build authorization, audit trails, and PHI minimization into your designs from the start.

• Work directly with product managers, practice managers, and clinicians. Come back from a twenty-minute conversation with a better spec than the one you were handed.

• Handle production incidents in your area without needing someone more senior to drive.

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and review code in a way that teaches.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering large, ambiguous features independently.

• Four-year undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Engineering. Rare exceptions for outstanding experience.

• Full-stack experience. You are comfortable owning a feature from the database to the browser.

• Strong TypeScript, including on the backend.

• Strong SQL: you write and tune non-trivial queries, read query plans, and design schemas for data that will outlive the feature.

• Data and analytics savvy. You are comfortable exploring an unfamiliar dataset, validating it, and turning it into reports or metrics that non-engineers trust.

• Production experience with React.

• Docker and container-based development and deployment.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

• Strong proficiency with AI development tools such as coding agents and assistants. You use them to move faster on the right work, review what they produce with the same rigor as any other code and know when a task is better done without them.

Preferred Qualifications

• Database modeling and migration frameworks such as Drizzle, Prisma, SQLAlchemy,

• Drive corrective action plans to closure and confirm sustained improvement.

Process Improvement

Adviseur financiële gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom)
description:
Zet jij je tanden graag in complexe gebiedsontwikkelingsopgaven? Word jij ook zo blij van het aansturen van een project dat gedurende je betrokkenheid fysiek vorm krijgt? Wil je ook bijdragen aan het creëren van de leefomgeving van de toekomst? Niet door rapporten te schrijven, maar door een ontwikkelstrategie te bedenken die écht wordt uitgevoerd. Of door het bouwen van een coalitie met marktpartijen en overheden. Leer jij het liefst door samen te werken met gedreven collega’s? En geloof jij net als wij in denken, durven én doen? Dan is TwynstraGudde voor jou ‘the place to be’!

Wij werken als adviseurs, kwartiermakers en managers aan complexe ruimtelijke vraagstukken van publieke, semipublieke en private partijen. Haalbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid zijn voor ons daarbij sleutelwoorden. Kenmerken van deze vraagstukken zijn de aanwezigheid van een maatschappelijke component, de complexe politiek bestuurlijke omgeving en het lokale of regionale schaalniveau. Wij zijn de adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie van TwynstraGudde.

Wij maken impact op morgen én op overmorgen. Creatief zijn we, soms grensverleggend en tegelijkertijd pragmatisch. Opdrachtgevers kunnen op ons rekenen: onze kracht is om van strategie tot realisatie te komen. Wij werken aan inbreidingslocaties voor woningbouw, spoorzones, transformatie van brownfields, herontwikkeling van zorgterreinen en reconstructies van verrommeld buitengebied. Help jij hen, samen met ons, vooruit?
Jouw rol
Als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom) werk je aan grote én kleine opgaven.
Je kunt producten als grondexploitaties, exploitatieplannen, residuele grondprijsberekeningen en businesscases ontwerpen, doorrekenen, beoordelen én deze financiële informatie vertalen zodat besluitvorming op verschillende niveaus (ambtelijk en bestuurlijk) kan plaatsvinden. Samen met andere financieel experts, projectleiders en/ of bestuurders kun je een ontwikkelstrategie uitdenken en uitvoeren. Het gaat hierbij ook vaak om samenwerkingsopgaven tussen partijen, waarbij je moet laveren tussen belangen. Je kijkt hierbij over de grenzen van het project en je eigen vakgebied heen. Samen met collega’s sta je klaar voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Je rol varieert sterk per project en omgeving. Hierin kun jij zelf je koers bepalen.
Jouw werkzaamheden

• Adviseren: doordat je inhoudelijk sterk bent, kun je opdrachtgevers van gedegen en diepgaand advies voorzien.

• Beslissingen nemen: je hakt knopen door als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom).

• Verbinden: je zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat er draagvlak ontstaat, bouwt aan coalities en verbindt partijen, in- en extern.

• Onderhandelen: je bent in staat om onderhandelingen te voeren met (markt)partijen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het sluiten van anterieure overeenkomsten.

• Managen: je overziet de te nemen stappen, zorg je voor integrale aansturing van het project en ben je gesprekspartner van bestuurders.

• Ontwikkelen: je denkt bewust na over je eigen leer- en ontwikkelpad en leert graag bij.

Je werkt aan meerdere kortlopende opdrachten naast elkaar of voor langere tijd aan één opdracht. Daarbij werk je zelfstandig of in teamverband en maak je natuurlijk ook deel uit van onze adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie, en van bredere samenwerkingsverbanden binnen het bureau als geheel.
Requirements
Jouw profiel
Je staat bekend als iemand die ruime kennis en ervaring heeft met de financiële kant van gebiedsontwikkelingen. Doordat je analytisch vaardig bent, kun je problemen snel identificeren en met je communicatieve kwaliteiten kun je tot de kern van vraagstukken komen. Je hebt gedegen kennis in huis van business cases, grondexploitaties en het inzetten van andere financiële instrumenten bij gebiedsontwikkelingen. Daarnaast zorgt jouw creativiteit voor haalbare oplossingen. Ook ben je in staat om processen te organiseren en draagvlak te creëren, en ben je creatief om tot haalbare oplossingen te kunnen komen. BRANDCIRCLE ist eine aufstrebende E-Commerce M&A Beratungs-Boutique mit Fokus auf der Abwicklung von M&A-Deals für Online-Händler in der Regel im Bereich von 2-40 Millionen € Jahresumsatz.
Wir als BRANDCIRCLE übernehmen eine strategische und operative Beratertätigkeit beim Verkauf von Assets und/oder Unternehmensanteilen für E-Commerce-Unternehmer, um den höchstmöglichen Verkaufswert für unsere Kunden zu erzielen. Für unsere Alumni, also Kunden, die erfolgreich gemeinsam mit uns verkauft haben, übernehmen wir auch das Management von Zukäufen anderer Marken/Unternehmen - die Tätigkeit erstreckt sich von der Akquise, über die Verhandlung und Dokumentenprüfung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Wir streben danach, unseren Kunden die bestmögliche Erfahrung mit unserer Beratung zu bieten. Dies erreichen wir durch exzellente Ergebnisse im Unternehmensverkauf und um dies zu schaffen, ist für uns eine vertrauensvolle, offene und zuverlässige Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden von zentraler Bedeutung.
Unser Prinzip: Built by Operators. Executed by Dealmakers. Wir sind keine klassische M&A-Boutique - wir sind Unternehmer, die selbst Marken aufgebaut und verkauft haben. Wir verstehen KPIs, Unit Economics und Pain Points unserer Kunden, weil wir sie selbst erlebt haben. Brandcircle versteht sich als Ökosystem, das Qualität und Kapital systematisch zusammenführt.
Aktuell suchen wir einen Deal Execution Manager (m/w/d), der unsere M&A-Mandate operativ orchestriert und unseren Deal Lead Lucas Beier substantiell entlastet - ohne dabei Geschwindigkeit oder Deal-Qualität zu verlieren.

KI ist dabei für uns kein Buzzword - sie ist unser operativer Hebel. Wir arbeiten täglich mit Claude, n8n und Make, um M&A-Prozesse zu automatisieren, die andere noch manuell abarbeiten. Wir sind ein erfolgsorientiertes Unternehmen und folgen dem Prinzip „Hire for attitude, train for skill" und bilden Dich in allen relevanten Dingen aus. Von Vorteil ist es, wenn Du die gleiche Sprache sprichst wie wir - und zwar nicht nur „E-Commerce M&A", sondern auch fließend Claude. In unserem Arbeitsalltag sind wir von der Lösung zu 100% Remote arbeiten zu können überzeugt und garantieren somit eine hohe Flexibilität!
Wenn Du Lust hast, M&A-Mandate operativ zu treiben, mit KI in jeder Phase echte Hebel zu setzen und vollen Einsatz für unsere Kunden zu geben, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! :)

title: Klinisch Psycholoog Online - Digitale poli
description:
Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
Geen wachtkamers of vaste kantoortijden, maar ruimte voor flexibel werken vanuit huis en volledig digitaal, zonder in te leveren op persoonlijk contact of kwaliteit. Bij de Digitale Poli maak je deel uit van een enthousiast team dat werkt aan snelle, doelgerichte zorg met oog voor herstel, veerkracht en zingeving. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de GGZ.
Wat ga je doen?
Als klinisch psycholoog ben je regiebehandelaar binnen een multidisciplinair online team. Je voert zelfstandig psychotherapie en diagnostiek uit, met aandacht voor complexe problematiek. Je begeleidt basispsychologen en GZ-psychologen in opleiding, en draagt actief bij aan hun professionele groei.
Je werkt vanuit huis, maar staat er niet alleen voor: via dagelijks contact in overleggen en samenwerking binnen behandelingen blijf je verbonden met het team. Daarnaast lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod en een inspirerende leeromgeving. Je taken bestaan onder andere uit: het voeren van intakes, opstellen en evalueren van behandelplannen, systeemgesprekken, deelnemen aan overleggen, uitvoeren van ROM-onderzoek en het ontwikkelen van (groeps)therapieën.
Wat hebben we jou te bieden?
Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.
Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGz) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.
Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

• Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 6.798,- tot € 9.442,- (FWG 75 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

• Een volledige dertiende maand (8,33% eindejaarsuitkering) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

• 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar (o.b.v. 36 uur per week). Extra tijd voor jezelf? Je kunt tot 36 uur extra verlof bijkopen.

• Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

• Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, collectieve inkomensverzekering en korting op aanvullende zorgverzekering (IZZ of Zilveren Kruis).

• Alflex, ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Kies bijv. voor een fiets, sportschoolabonnement of reiskostenvergoeding.

• Ruimte en mogelijkheden voor (door)groei! Je kunt scholingen volgen bij de Altrecht Academie, deelnemen aan organisatiebrede kennis & expertisenetwerken, meewerken aan onderzoek of jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de praktijk, via opleidingen en intervisie.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent een klinisch psycholoog met een nieuwsgierige en innovatieve houding. Je ziet kansen in digitale zorg en durft te pionieren in een dynamisch en veranderend veld. Tegelijkertijd werk je zorgvuldig en zelfstandig, met een scherp oog voor complexe problematiek en het vermogen om regie te houden over behandelingen. Je gelooft in herstelgerichte zorg, werkt vanuit het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid en zet digitale middelen doelgericht in om écht van betekenis te zijn voor de cliënt.
Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die collega’s weet te begeleiden en graag bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod. Je hebt ervaring met individuele en groepsbehandelingen, blijft rustig in hectiek en schakelt snel wanneer dat nodig is. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, bent BIG-geregistreerd als klinisch psycholoog - of je bent bijna klaar met je opleiding - en je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verb

title: Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) - New Bedford, MA
description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
